dct_title_s: Bathymetric map : Gulf of Mexico, Orca Basin
dct_description_sm: Depths shown by isolines and gradient tints.
In margin: "3-Dimensional View. Scale 1:600,000. Viewing angle 35° from horizontal. Vertical exaggeration 6:1."
Includes NOS survey index and information, index to adjoining sheets, depth gradient diagram, and LORAN linear interpolator.
Also available via the Internet from the NGDC NOAA web site. Address as of 2/15/08: http://www.ngdc.noaa.gov/mgg/bathymetry/maps/previews/LM-161.pdf; current access via PURL.
